TestDecodeGoldenV2 lost only the assertion on the removed MsgOnlyChecksum flag, which carried no RFC 3768 content, and TestNegativeReferenceBugs gained the FillChecksum mode argument and an rfc5798-compatible lookup in N1 alone; verifyReceived returns before any mode is read for version 2, so the VRRPv2 decode under judgement is unchanged. TestDecodeV2DiscardsUnknownType still refuses Type 0, 2 and 15 with ErrType over a recomputed checksum. Verdict unchanged.
